notes.title: Nominate VSII for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hey Vestaria Saga fans!

We hope you enjoyed the release of Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister earlier this year!

If you're a fan of Vestaria Saga's storyline involving Zade and his companions, please consider nominating VSII for this year's Steam Award for 'Outstanding Story-Rich Game'!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41619614/1f50e6d7c8cbcc1420bada4d43f92a3a472c91ee.png[/img]

Thank you for the continued support!

notes.title: Vestaria Saga II has officially released!
notes.content:
The day has finally come! We are pleased to officially release [b]Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister[/b] to the world!

This has been a passion project and we sincerely hope that fans of not only the Vestaria Saga series, but strategy RPGs of all kind will enjoy this next chapter in the series.

Please let us know your thoughts in the community forums, and if you enjoy this title, please consider giving it a review!

Thank you all for your continued support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41619614/fc06f589fceff44a3cd4aa05b65ecfd69a98c3a9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Vestaria Saga II Release Date Set For July 28th, 2022!
notes.content:
Mark your calendars, Vestaria Saga fans! 

[b]Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister[/b] will be officially releasing on Steam on July 28th, 2022!

Be sure to check out the new trailer on the store page!
[previewyoutube=xRuNxyaHpUY;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you are looking forward to continuing Zade's adventure this summer!
